title: Mutation Completion — not_checked Root Cause & Run Completion

not_checked_root_cause.one_line: not_checked meant 'never executed'. The mutation subprocess was killed by the runner's own max_runtime before the slowest-scheduled mutants were reached. It was NOT a missing-test, fixture, import, cache, PYTHONPATH, test-selection, or mutation-generation problem.
not_checked_root_cause.defect_class: execution_time_and_resource_limit_configuration (not a code defect in the runner logic)
not_checked_root_cause.resolution: Re-run using the runner's already-supported --max-runtime and --max-children flags. Parallelism (--max-children 4 on a 4-CPU host) reduced loan wall-clock from >1800s (truncated) to 653s (complete).

authoritative_semantics.meaning: not_checked is the status when a mutant has NO recorded exit code, i.e. it was never executed at all.
authoritative_semantics.critical_disambiguation: mutmut/__main__.py lines 1461-1464 assign exit code 33 ('no tests') when a mutant's function has NO associated tests. Therefore 'no covering tests' produces status 'no tests', NEVER 'not checked'. Any claim that not_checked means 'no covering tests' is provably false for mutmut 3.7.0.

evidence_chain.finding: Reproduced the M9-C42.18 loan population exactly from the live cache: 1273 = 834 killed + 152 survived + 3 timeout + 4 no_tests + 280 not_checked.
evidence_chain.conclusion: Prior evidence is reproducible; investigation starts from a trustworthy base.

evidence_chain.finding: The 280 not_checked mutants are NOT randomly distributed. They cluster into exactly 6 functions: x_generate_schedule (171/171), x__add_months (58/58), x__required_emi (27/27), x_total_interest_paise (4/4), x_bps_to_monthly_rate (4/4) — all FULLY unevaluated — plus x_regenerate_schedule (16/67) PARTIALLY unevaluated.
evidence_chain.conclusion: A single partially-evaluated function is the signature of a run that STOPPED, not of a rule that SKIPS.

evidence_chain.finding: All 6 affected functions HAVE associated tests in mutants/mutmut-stats.json: generate_schedule 167 tests, _add_months 176, _required_emi 36, total_interest_paise 76, bps_to_monthly_rate 193, regenerate_schedule 66.
evidence_chain.conclusion: The 'no covering tests' hypothesis is DISPROVEN. Combined with exit code 33 semantics, missing tests cannot produce not_checked.

evidence_chain.finding: Mutant source code for representative not_checked mutants (x_regenerate_schedule__mutmut_37, __mutmut_54) was inspected in mutants/src/engines/loan_engine/prepayment.py and is well-formed, complete, and syntactically valid.
evidence_chain.conclusion: Mutation GENERATION succeeded. The defect is in EXECUTION/scheduling, not generation.

evidence_chain.finding: mutmut/__main__.py line 1441 sorts the mutant queue by estimated_worst_case_time ASCENDING (fastest first). Correlating every mutant's status against its estimated execution time yields a perfectly monotonic cutoff.
evidence_chain.conclusion: not_checked status is a PURE FUNCTION of estimated execution time, with a single clean cutoff at ~4.1s. Deciles 1-7 are 100% evaluated; deciles 9-10 are 100% not_checked. This is the exact signature of wall-clock truncation against mutmut's fastest-first schedule. No test-selection, fixture, import, or generation hypothesis can produce a monotonic time-ordered cutoff.

evidence_chain.finding: Runner mutation_runner.py line 531: timeout = max_runtime or DEFAULT_RUNTIME.get(mode, 5400); DEFAULT_RUNTIME['target'] = 1800. Lines 564-575: on TimeoutExpired the ENTIRE process group is SIGTERM+SIGKILLed. Default --max-children = 0 (serial execution). Total estimated serial time for the full loan population = 3409s, which EXCEEDS the 1800s target budget.
evidence_chain.conclusion: The arithmetic is conclusive: 3409s of work cannot fit in an 1800s budget when run serially. Truncation was inevitable and deterministic.

evidence_chain.finding: Cross-engine control: credit_card_engine evaluated all 582 mutants in 93 seconds (M9-C42.17 reproduction artifact) and account_engine 183 mutants quickly — both far inside 1800s, both with not_checked = 0.
evidence_chain.conclusion: Explains precisely why the two 'complete' engines had zero not_checked while loan and reconciliation had hundreds: population size x per-mutant cost vs a fixed wall-clock budget. Nothing about those engines' fixtures or configuration differed in a way that mattered.

hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.intentionally_skipped: REJECTED — mutmut emits exit code 34 ('skipped') for skips; zero skipped observed.

hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.test_selection_defect: REJECTED — pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection resolved correctly; 993 mutants in the same scope were evaluated successfully by the same selection.
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.fixture_or_pytest_plugins_defect: REJECTED — same fixtures served the 993 evaluated mutants in the identical run.
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.pythonpath_defect: REJECTED — same PYTHONPATH served the 993 evaluated mutants.
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.also_copy_defect: REJECTED for loan (also_copy=['src'] sufficed for 993 evaluations); VERIFIED PRESENT AND WORKING for reconciliation (mutants/tests/unit/engines/reconciliation/test_reconciliation.py confirmed copied).
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.cache_corruption: REJECTED — runner deletes mutants/ and .mutmut-cache before each target run (lines 489-496); cache provenance validated.
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.timeout_cascade: REJECTED as PRIMARY cause — only 3-4 genuine per-mutant 'timeout' statuses exist, which are separately and correctly classified.
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.resource_limitation_memory: NOT the cause — 4 CPUs / 7GB sufficed; the completed parallel re-run succeeded on the same host.
hypotheses_explicitly_tested_and_rejecte.unsupported_mutation_locations: REJECTED — the same functions produced killed/survived results in the completed re-run.

m9_c42_18_stated_cause_correction.m9_c42_18_claim: "Run incomplete; 280 mutants not checked (no covering tests)" and "280/1,273 mutants not checked (no covering tests)"
m9_c42_18_stated_cause_correction.disproof: All 6 affected functions have 36-193 associated tests recorded in mutmut-stats.json. mutmut 3.7.0 assigns exit code 33 -> status 'no tests' when tests are absent, so 'no covering tests' can never yield 'not checked'. The true cause is wall-clock truncation.
m9_c42_18_stated_cause_correction.impact_of_the_error: M9-C42.18's stated remediation ('Add tests covering loan_engine not_checked mutants (280)' and the same for reconciliation) would have added ~546 unnecessary tests to chase mutants that already had ample test coverage and merely needed to be executed. This phase's correction avoids that wasted and metric-driven work entirely.

secondary_defect_found.name: post_run_reporting_context_defect
secondary_defect_found.severity: MEDIUM — evidence-reporting integrity, no data loss
secondary_defect_found.symptom: After ANY successful `mutation --target <engine>` run, the runner prints and persists killed=survived=...=0, mutants_generated=0, mutation_score=None, evidence_complete=false, while still reporting execution_status=PASS and exit code 0.
secondary_defect_found.root_cause: mutation_runner.py restores the PRE-RUN [tool.mutmut] block in the `finally` block (lines 605-608) BEFORE collecting evidence via `mutmut results --all true` (lines 638-646). The restored block usually names a DIFFERENT engine's source_paths. `mutmut results` resolves the mutant population from the CURRENT config's source_paths, finds no mutants matching the wrong scope, and returns an empty result set. parse_mutmut_results() therefore parses zero lines and returns an all-zero MutationCounts.
secondary_defect_found.authoritative_data_location: mutants/src/**/<file>.py.meta -> exit_code_by_key (one entry per mutant, with mutmut's raw exit code)
secondary_defect_found.why_gate_b_caught_it: reconcile_counts() + evidence_complete requires counts.generated > 0, so the zero population correctly produced Gate B (Evidence Integrity) FAIL rather than a fake 0% score. The runner's no-fake-score guarantee held.
secondary_defect_found.explains_baseline_anomaly: This is the origin of the stale mutation-summary.json found in Phase 1 (credit_card_engine, mutants_generated=0, execution_status=PASS).
secondary_defect_found.remediation_applied_this_phase: NONE (no code change). Authoritative counts were recovered from the .meta files and independently re-verified by reinstalling the correct per-engine config and re-running `mutmut results --all true`, which returned the full population. Recommended fix is deferred as an explicit, evidence-supported recommendation.
secondary_defect_found.recommended_fix: In mutation_runner.py, collect evidence (`mutmut results --all true`) BEFORE restoring the pre-run [tool.mutmut] block; or pass the engine-scoped config explicitly to the results invocation. Smallest correct change: move the results collection above the config restoration in the finally-block ordering.

runs_executed_this_phase.also_copy_fix_verified: M9-C42.17's EngineSelection.also_copy=('src','tests') confirmed ACTIVE and WORKING: mutants/tests/unit/engines/reconciliation/test_reconciliation.py present in the mutant tree; all three test selections (unit, properties, capability) configured.
runs_executed_this_phase.also_copy_eliminated_not_checked: NO — the also_copy fix was necessary but NOT the cause of the 266 not_checked. The cause was wall-clock truncation; parallel re-execution with adequate budget eliminated it.

infrastructure_changes_made.rationale: The root cause was a resource-budget configuration issue, fully addressable via the runner's existing --max-runtime and --max-children CLI flags. No mutation-runner or contract code was modified. In particular, nothing was changed to hide, reclassify, or suppress not_checked.
